_readme: Draw data for the hand-drawn onboarding art. Coordinates are in each drawing's viewBox [minX, minY, width, height]. Draw items in list order; animate by seq (items sharing a seq start together). rotationDeg follows Pencil: positive = counter-clockwise around the item's top-left (x, y). text y is the TOP of the text box; baseline = y + fontSize * 0.98. sparkle = 4-point star path "M0 -7 Q0 0 7 0 Q0 0 0 7 Q0 0 -7 0 Q0 0 0 -7 Z" scaled by scale, translated to (x, y), stroke 2.2. fill paths are offset +3 (intro/empty) or +2 (icons) from their outline on purpose (misregistered marker look). loop = idle animation tag after draw-on (pulse, scan, up, drive).
